title: The Copilot Compass
deckTitle: The Copilot Compass: Finding True North Across Copilot, Cowork, Scout, and Agents
summary: Copilot is one app (Home, Code, Autopilot) with four directions and two meters. Pick the mode by the finish line: Chat to sharpen, Cowork to delegate, Autopilot to monitor, Code/agents to scale.
whyItMatters: Choosing the right mode for each job is the difference between productivity and wasted credits.

keyPoints.heading: Scout is now Autopilot
keyPoints.text: Renamed Sept 25, 2026; moved from a local desktop engine to the cloud with its own identity, memory, and workspace; billed in Copilot Credits; private preview, broad rollout by year end.

keyPoints.heading: North - Sharpen (Chat)
keyPoints.text: In-the-moment thinking; included in the seat license.

keyPoints.heading: South - Delegate (Cowork)
keyPoints.text: Defined deliverable handed back finished; Copilot Credits.

keyPoints.heading: East - Monitor (Autopilot)
keyPoints.text: Ongoing job with no finish line; Copilot Credits.

keyPoints.heading: West - Scale (Code, Agent Builder, Copilot Studio)
keyPoints.text: Whole team does it the same way; cost depends on builder. Build ladder: Code to build, Agent Builder to prove, Copilot Studio to run.

keyPoints.heading: Office apps act now
keyPoints.text: Excel plans then builds; PowerPoint builds decks from meetings and files on brand (give it an outline and source data); Word revises with Track Changes; OpenAI and Anthropic models.

keyPoints.heading: Rule of three
keyPoints.text: Done it three times by hand? Make it an agent.

keyPoints.heading: Pitfalls
keyPoints.text: Swiss Army chatbot, credits on autopilot, human copy-paste middleware, Autopilot with no guardrails, rolling out tools not workflows.

anthony: GCC availability is still an issue.
